An '''Untarr''' was a type of double-pointed [[Spear/Legends|spear]]. The [[Ebranite]] [[Rith Tar'ak]] used an Untarr during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Adventure Journal 11" />

==Behind the scenes==
Untarrs were mentioned in the "[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)|Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]" article included in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[November]] [[1996]]. The article was written by [[Craig Robert Carey]] and [[Trevor J. Wilson]].<ref name="Adventure Journal 11" />
